jurisdiction.name: Nepal
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Nepal governs AI mainly through the National AI Policy 2082 (2025), which creates an AI Regulation Council and a National AI Centre under the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology and built on a 2024 ministry concept paper on AI use. There is no AI law yet; the Privacy Act 2075 (2018) is the general data protection law, and the central bank (Nepal Rastra Bank) put draft AI guidelines for financial institutions out for comment in December 2025.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Communication and Information Technology
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. The Cabinet's approval date for the AI Policy could not be confirmed from an official source, so the policy is dated by year only.

instruments.current_status: Nepali text published on the Nepal Law Commission portal (posted 6 Asoj 2083, 22 September 2026); MoCIT published the official English version 'National Artificial Intelligence (A.I.) Policy, 2025' on 11 Mangsir 2082 (27 November 2025) at https://www.mocit.gov.np/content/13111/nationalai---policy---/. The documents do not state the Cabinet approval date. Not yet verified from the official text: approval by the Council of Ministers in August 2025.
instruments.summary: Nepal's first national AI policy, setting a vision of a human-centred, ethical and prosperous Nepal through AI, with goals, strategies and 60-plus action policies on AI laws (data security law, risk-based AI law, amending sectoral laws), infrastructure, skills, research, public services and an AI regulatory sandbox. It creates an AI Regulation Council chaired by the Minister of Communication and Information Technology to issue guidance and approve standards on fairness, transparency, accountability and human rights, a National AI Centre under the ministry as its secretariat and regulator-facilitator, and AI Excellence Centres. It applies as a guiding policy for provinces and local levels, includes a risk identification section and an implementation action plan (Schedule 1), and is to be reviewed every two years.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Nepal's central AI governance instrument; founding document for the AI Regulation Council and the National AI Centre.

instruments.summary: Committee report forming the government's first concept paper on AI, reviewing AI concepts, Nepal's existing situation and policy arrangements, international AI strategies, opportunities, problems and risks. It recommends an AI policy framework, a national AI strategy, a data protection framework and sectoral regulation, a dedicated nodal agency, AI standardisation, a national AI portal, digital literacy, R&D and sectoral uses (health, agriculture and others).

instruments.current_status: Published for comments by NRB notice no. 13/2082-83 dated 7 December 2025 (draft dated December 2025). No final version was found on nrb.org.np as of 12 October 2026.
instruments.summary: Draft guidelines from Nepal's central bank for the AI use of licensed banks and financial institutions, issued following the monetary policy announcement. They require board-approved AI governance and accountability (including an AI steering committee), risk classification and management of AI systems including high-risk systems and third-party/generative AI tools, transparency and explainability, data privacy, fairness and non-discrimination, human oversight, monitoring, customer grievance handling, and annual reporting of AI activities to NRB (Annex A).
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First sector regulator AI rules in Nepal (financial sector).

instruments.current_status: Act no. 14 of 2075, authenticated 2075/6/2 (18 September 2018); commenced immediately (s.1(2)). No AI-specific provisions. Amendments after 2018 not checked.
instruments.summary: Nepal's general privacy law, giving effect to the constitutional right to privacy of body, residence, property, documents, data, correspondence and character. It regulates the collection, processing, storage and disclosure of personal information (including sensitive information) by public bodies and other institutions, generally requiring consent, and sets offences and compensation for privacy violations.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Main data protection law governing personal data used in AI systems; the National AI Policy calls for a further data security law.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Nepal's law commission portal, the information and communications technology ministry, other ministries and the central bank were searched. Records include the national AI policy, an AI concept paper and the central bank's draft AI guidelines; no AI-specific law or bill was found, and there was no material for public-sector use, procurement, cybersecurity, transparency, standards, indices or international instruments. Not yet verified from the official text: material in the gazette, parliament's bills and of the telecoms authority and the standards and procurement bodies, and the Cabinet approval date of the AI policy.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. Gazette (rajpatra) and parliament.gov.np not searched separately; Digital Nepal Framework 2.0 AI parts, NTA, standards bodies and PPMO not reached; opmcm records for the Shrawan 2082 decision not found. Bare mocit.gov.np fails its TLS certificate (www.mocit.gov.np works). Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Nepal Law Commission portal (AI policy page, Privacy Act 2075); no AI-specific Act, AI bill or AI provision in other laws found. Gazette (rajpatra) and parliament.gov.np not searched separately in the time box.; Government: MoCIT: National AI Policy 2082 (Nepali + official English), AI concept paper 2024. Digital Nepal Framework not re-read for AI parts (time box).; Ministries: Searched only via general queries; no education/health/justice/finance ministry AI documents found.; Regulators: Nepal Rastra Bank: draft AI Guidelines (Dec 2025). No data protection authority exists; NTA and cyber/standards bodies: no AI-specific documents found in search.. Not reached: rajpatra.dop.gov.np gazette search; parliament.gov.np bills; Digital Nepal Framework AI pillar review; Nepal Telecommunications Authority site search; Nepal Bureau of Standards and Metrology; Public Procurement Monitoring Office; opmcm.gov.np cabinet decisions for Shrawan 2082 (search and guessed archive URLs returned nothing; MoCIT cabinet-decision listing shows only 2083 items on page 1). Could not verify: Cabinet approval date of the AI Policy; Final NRB AI Guidelines; Founding instrument of the National AI Centre. public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, index-readiness, international: no material found.
